notes.title: Simultaneous soundtrack release!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43509652/46cacf9f4c8eb118833c172334a93f2e89ba6914.png
"Red List Girls.-Andean Flamingo-" used in the A soundtrack with 23 BGM tracks will be released on the same day as the game release.

4:Use for commercial or non-commercial purposes is permitted.
5:Use for illegal activities is strictly prohibited.
6:Redistribution is prohibited for both commercial and non-commercial use.
